bio: Championed by The Guardian as the city's 'most opulent boutique hotel', Prestonfield presents an historical setting, filled with luxury. Guests can bask in the lavish dining room, or the rolling acres of the garden during summer and enjoy a traditional Afternoon Tea.  Afternoon Tea is a luxurious Prestonfield tradition and a memorable occasion, whether served by the side of a roaring log fire or, in summer, in the rose-filled gardens or the whimsical gothic tea house. The dining room at Prestonfield Edinburgh is filled with rich plush fabrics and baroque-style features.  Enjoy a tantalising selection of leaf teas, exceptional home baking, scones and delicious finger sandwiches in the most indulgent of surroundings. Afternoon tea is served daily throughout Prestonfield and in summer in the rose gardens, the gothic tea house or on the terrace.
